name: youth_group_josh
tag: wednesdays at 7. theres pizza. thats it thats the headline
blogTitle: why i dont pick sides (and why thats not the same as not caring)
about: hey im josh =] i go to youth group wednesdays at 7 and yes im gonna invite u, its just what i do. mostly i like hanging out and listening to ppl, so if ur having a rough week my aim is always on and i mean always. also i will beat anyone on this site at halo 2 and i say that with love.
meet: Who I'd like to meet: honestly anyone. Jon Foreman from switchfoot. and whoever keeps sniping me on lockout so i can shake their hand and then never play them again.

interests.General: youth group wednesdays, halo 2 on xbox live (gamertag youthgroupjosh), ultimate frisbee, lock-ins, serving at the soup kitchen 1st saturdays, being the guy everyone aims at 1am, pizza
interests.Music: relient k, switchfoot, anberlin, underoath (they count), mae, mewithoutYou, copeland, jars of clay (its my moms cd but its good), fall out boy (dont tell pastor dan)
interests.Movies: napoleon dynamite (still quote it, not sorry), nacho libre, facing the giants, remember the titans, lord of the rings extended editions (all 3 in one lock-in, we did it)
interests.Television: the office, lost (i have theories), smallville, veggie tales (ironically) (mostly)
interests.Books: blue like jazz, the chronicles of narnia, left behind (dont judge), my bible (the student one w/ the notes in the margins), halo: the fall of reach
interests.Heroes: my youth pastor dan, my mom, master chief, jon foreman, anyone who actually listens when u talk
